examples.label: Example 5.1
examples.question: Hydrogen gas and oxygen gas react to give liquid water in an exothermic reaction.
solution: 571.6 kJ heat energy is evolved during this reaction. If the energy evolved is shown separately it is expressed as ΔH = -571.6 kJ.
The same amount of energy will be absorbed when the reaction will move in the backward direction i.e. water will decompose to give hydrogen and oxygen back.

examples.label: Example 5.2
examples.question:
Calculate the enthalpy change of the following chemical reaction.

H₂(g) + I₂(g) → 2 HI(g)

Bond energies of H₂, I₂ and HI are 436,151, and -299 kJ mol⁻¹ respectively.
